title: Treatment 3 Controlled Experiment Design
purpose: Design a new controlled test of the reliability-sensitive information-flow contamination mechanism.

mechanistic_target.name: reliability_sensitive_information_flow_contamination
mechanistic_target.hypothesis: When an unreliable agent's information is allowed to enter the shared reasoning state, collective performance can decrease relative to a matched condition in which that unreliable information is excluded.
mechanistic_target.causal_prediction: Holding the underlying problem, reliable-agent information, model, prompt structure, and output contract constant, exposure to unreliable information should increase the probability of an incorrect final answer.
mechanistic_target.falsification_condition: If controlled exposure to unreliable information does not produce the predicted degradation relative to the matched exclusion condition, the proposed contamination mechanism is not supported under the tested conditions.

C0_reliable_only.description: Only reliable-agent information is admitted into the shared reasoning state.

C1_unreliable_exposed.description: The same reliable-agent information is present, but controlled unreliable-agent information is also admitted into the shared reasoning state.

treatment_3.independent_variable: Whether controlled unreliable information is admitted into the shared reasoning state.
treatment_3.dependent_variable: Final-answer correctness under the predetermined ground truth.

replication_plan.reason: Use matched problem instances so the principal contrast is information exposure rather than problem composition.

outcome_logic.supports_mechanism: C1 shows a reproducible degradation in correctness relative to C0 under the matched controlled comparison.
outcome_logic.does_not_support_mechanism: C1 does not degrade relative to C0, or the observed difference is not reproducible under the predefined analysis.
outcome_logic.stronger_support: The degradation is accompanied by evidence that final reasoning incorporates or depends upon the injected unreliable information.
outcome_logic.important_boundary: A performance difference alone does not prove the complete causal mechanism; information-flow evidence is required for a stronger mechanistic claim.

scientific_boundaries: Does not reproduce historical Agent A/B/C model assignments.
Does not infer the missing historical mapping.
Does not modify historical Treatment 1 or Treatment 2 artifacts.
Does not select problems post hoc.
Does not alter the proposed mechanism after seeing results.
